heading: Rooted in the Orthodox Tewahedo faith, shaped for New York life.
paragraphs: OTY NYC’s mission is to guide young Orthodox Tewahedo Christians into a deeper understanding of their faith and to support them in living an authentic Orthodox life in the midst of the challenges of living in New York City.

We strive to provide the core knowledge of the Church’s history, dogma, canons, and rites that many have not had the opportunity to learn, while also fostering fellowship, service, and mentorship that strengthens both spiritual and everyday life.
